ops.title: Get your center running
ops.intro: Work through the steps below. Each one is ticked off automatically once your center's data shows it is done.

branches.title: Create campuses and rooms
branches.description: Each campus has its own time zone; online classes belong to the virtual "Online" campus.

staff.title: Add staff and teachers
staff.description: Give everyone their roles and set an hourly rate for each teacher.

programs.title: Create programs and levels
programs.description: Pick the language, the proficiency framework (JLPT, CEFR, HSK…) and the lessons per level.

classes.title: Open classes and schedule them
classes.description: Choose weekdays, time and teacher; lessons are generated automatically, skipping holidays.

students.title: Add students and issue accounts
students.description: The temporary password is shown once; students change it at their first sign-in.

billing.title: Create packages, orders and take payments
billing.description: Once an order is fully paid the student is placed in the class automatically.

payroll.title: Create and lock pay periods
payroll.description: Teaching time is counted from the lessons; locking a period freezes the rates.

leads.title: Follow up on new leads
leads.description: Sign-ups from the public site land here; update the status after each contact.

teach.title: How the teacher area works
teach.intro: Everything about a lesson starts on this page.

schedule.title: Check your schedule
schedule.description: Upcoming lessons in the center's time zone, online or on campus.

join.title: Join the class
join.description: The "Join" button appears once the room is ready; click it to open the room.

attendance.title: Take attendance
attendance.description: Online lessons come with a draft from the room data; check it, correct it and confirm. Lessons are deducted only after you confirm.

timesheet.title: Check this month's hours
timesheet.description: Lessons, counted minutes and the estimated amount are at the bottom of the page.

learn.title: How the student portal works
learn.intro: Keep track of your learning right here.

credits.title: Lessons left
credits.description: Paid and bonus lessons; excused absences are not deducted.

schedule.title: Your schedule
schedule.description: Upcoming lessons in the center's time zone.

join.title: Join the class
join.description: The "Join" button appears once the room is ready, usually shortly before the lesson.

replay.title: Watch past lessons
replay.description: Recordings of past lessons are in the Replay section.

password.title: Change your password
password.description: Change it at any time to keep your account safe.
